lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode: a stubborn old car flipper on a TV quiz loses the million-question to a bot. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Lines: 1 cocky; 2 confident, smug; 3 loud; 4 indignant; 5 on the phone, hurried; 6 stubborn, loud; 7 tired, deadpan.

stas.profile: Stas — a calm, confident young Russian used-car flipper in his 30s, a bit cheeky.
stas.notes: One line: on the phone, relaxed, slightly amused.

host.profile: Arkady — a smooth, theatrical Russian TV quiz show host in a tuxedo; warm, dramatic pauses, showman intonation.
host.notes: Lines: 1 dramatic question; 2 reading the four options clearly; 3 teasing; 4 announcing; 5 dramatic 'wrong', then cheerful about the consolation prize.
